quest.title: The Best Audience in All of Mondstadt
quest.description: An adventure story has gotten Jack all excited. He's desperate for someone to help him track down the monster from the story...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: *sigh* What I would give to see it for myself...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See what?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Whoa, how long have you been there!?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Yesterday, Stanley got drunk and told me all about this adventure he once had at <color=#00E1FFFF>Dadaupa Gorge</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: He said, and I quote: "The monster was burning fiercely as its amorphous body wriggled slowly towards me... I fought and I screamed, but it didn't seem to do anything; the monster just looked at me contemptuously with those eyes... those terrifying eyes..."

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Obviously I wasn't there to see it, but... if even Stanley felt he had met his match that time, it must have been one epic adventure.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: *sigh* I am so tempted to try and find the monster that even Stanley struggled to beat... Just to see it...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: But knowing what I'm like in a fight, it would probably end in me getting beaten up and running away.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Hey, do you think maybe you could go find the monster for me? Only if you're interested, of course.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Brilliant! Knew I could rely on you.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Oh boy, I would love to... But unfortunately, I have a million other things that need doing.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: When I say "other things..." Unfortunately, just doing adventures for the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild doesn't bring in enough of an income.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: So I've taken to doing a bunch of odd jobs for people around town. Finding missing cats, cutting the grass, you name it...

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: So the epic adventure of Stanley-scaring proportions is all yours. Tell me all about the monster when you get back, I want to hear everything!

talks.objective: Find the monster based on Jack's description

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: *sigh* When oh when will I finally become an epic Adventurer...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Oh, hi... Yesterday, Cyrus was telling me about an adventure he once had. It was in the <color=#00E1FFFF>Stormbearer Mountains</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: In his words: "That huge shield was like something out of a nightmare, no matter how hard my sword struck it, it just wouldn't budge... Meanwhile, the monster sneered at me from behind the shield, glaring contemptuously with those eyes... those terrifying eyes..."

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: A Wooden Shield impervious to all attacks... I would give anything to see that with my own eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: But I have a billion other things to do that I just can't get out of... I can't begin to imagine what kind of terrifying monster would have a shield like the one Stanley described...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Hey, so... If you were at all interested, maybe you could go and find the monster for me?

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Fantastic! Thanks so much. I want to hear all about it when you get back — every last detail!

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: You want me to come? Sorry, I just can't. The Adventurers' Guild has a load of odd jobs waiting for me.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Adventures just aren't that lucrative these days. Even though I got these jobs via the Adventurers' Guild, in actual fact most of them are just running errands for other people.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: I need to herd some boars for Draff, find Margaret's cat, pick some fresh flowers for Flora...

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: ...Not quite the sorts of adventures I was imagining when I signed up with the Guild. Haha.

talks.objective: Find the monster based on Jack's description

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon really can't see how this is the same monster Jack was talking about...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe he just got his monster facts mixed up? Anyway, let's go and find him.

talks.objective: Find the monster based on Jack's description

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: "The monster was burning fiercely as its amorphous body wriggled slowly towards me... I fought and I screamed, but it didn't seem to do anything; the monster just looked at me contemptuously with those eyes... those terrifying eyes..."

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: That's how Stanley described the monster. He also said that he only managed to defeat it because eventually — and this took every last ounce of his strength, apparently — he extinguished the flames on its body.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: But every time I ask him how, he refuses to elaborate. I wonder what tricks Stanley is hiding up his sleeve...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: I just want to get out there on an adventure...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Stanley told me another one of his stories yesterday.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: This time he was even drunker than usual, so it was quite incoherent... But from what I could tell, it took place near <color=#00E1FFFF>Dawn Winery</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: The salient parts of his drunken ramblings were as follows... "There were ominous-looking ice crystals on the monster's body, as if to make it look larger, more intimidating... My legs froze with fear as I frantically flailed my weapon around... I dislodged a few shards of ice; brilliant, shining ice... Somehow I was transfixed by that ice..."

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: I can't imagine the kind of monster it would take for even Stanley to feel like he'd finally met his match.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Oh, I do wish I could go and see it for myself... But knowing me, it'd have me running for my life before I got anywhere near it.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: ...You'd be fine, though. Knowing you. Would you be willing to go look for it for me?

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Excellent! When you find it, come back and tell me all about it!

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: I'd really love to come. But with everything that's going on with the Adventurers' Guild... You know how it is.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Cyrus looks like he's about to retire — says he wants to settle down in Springvale.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Herman hasn't left the city once since his daughter was born. It's such a loss. He was our star Adventurer, no doubt about it.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Meanwhile, Stanley's on extended leave and hasn't been on an adventure in ages.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: The Guild has started taking on odd jobs from the public as way to cover its running costs, but they're still struggling to find people to do them.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: So it's fallen to me to cover the shortage. We can't expect Bennett to do it, he's got more than enough to deal with already.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is it just Paimon or do neither the shield nor the monster Jack described match what we encountered here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon reckons he just got two different stories mixed up. Anyway, let's go and find him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh-oh! Something's coming, there really is something here after all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait... It's just a Slime. Although... it is burning, and wriggling too...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Surely the monster Jack was talking about wasn't just a pesky Slime?

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: Jack, hear me out... It's not like that...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: But... Ah, you're back! How was it? Did you find the monster?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, although...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: A Pyro Slime... Is that it? Impossible. That's not how Stanley described it at all!

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Good thing the man himself is right here! Go on Stanley, tell them about that adventure.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: You know, the monster who burned fiercely...

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: Oh, uh... that one, yeah, yeah... I was, uh, really drunk that day and... you know, I just don't remember it so clearly—

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Not a problem my good friend! I remember everything you told me — look, I have it written down here, word for word.

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: Wow... But hey Jack, I just remembered this other story I totally forgot to tell you about before! It's from way, way back when I was...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Jack, I'm telling you, adventuring is something you need to go out and do for yourself...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: I appreciate that, but... Oh, you're back! How was it? Found the monster?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yup.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Amazing! What was it? ...Sorry? Did you just say a hilichurl? With a regular wooden shield?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: No way, that's just not possible. Cyrus must have been talking about something else... Are you sure you went to the right place?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Good thing Cyrus is right here so he can clear it up. Cyrus, what do you make of this?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Hmm... Er... Yes, you're absolutely right Jack, certainly not the same monster that I encountered.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Why is Cyrus winking at us like his life depends on it?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Hahaha... Well I never. In a way it's a good thing — if such terrifying monsters were that easy to find, I'd never dare set foot outside the city!

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: Thank you for your efforts. I must be going now, I have business to attend to.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: ...Alright, I'm sorry. Please, stop looking at me like that.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So... a hilichurl?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Yes, alright, it's true. It was just a hilichurl in that story I told.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: *sigh* But look... As you know, every young person in Mondstadt has their heart set on joining the Knights of Favonius. Trying to convince them to sign up with the Adventurers' Guild is like trying to get Barbatos to trade his Holy Lyre for two twigs and a ball of string...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: The reason? The Knights of Favonius takes on dragons while the Adventurers' Guild is stuck dealing with the likes of the hilichurls.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Our recruitment drive desperately needs more gripping stories... Otherwise, we're just not going to sign up a single new recruit.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: I know making up stories is futile... But what else can I do? I'm far too old to be going out there fighting epic battles against legendary monsters for real.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: *sigh* I do worry for the future of Mondstadt's Adventurers' Guild after I retire...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: "That huge shield was like something out of a nightmare, no matter how hard my sword struck it, it just wouldn't budge... Meanwhile, the monster sneered at me from behind the shield, glaring contemptuously with those eyes... those terrifying eyes..."

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: That's what Cyrus told me. I remember it very specifically.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: He also told me that the key to defeating this monster was focusing on the shield first and finding a clever way to quickly destroy it.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Otherwise, once he lifts his shield up there's just no way to get a hit on him. No matter how good your swordsmanship is.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Finally, Cyrus said, this monster waits for the perfect opportunity to strike. As soon as you let your guard down, even for a split second, it unleashes its ferocious attack.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: The ability to take down a monster like that is what makes Cyrus a true giant among Adventurers.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: *sigh* I don't think I could ever hope to reach that level...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: "There were ominous-looking ice crystals on the monster's body, as if to make it look larger, more intimidating... My legs froze with fear as I frantically flailed my weapon around... I dislodged a few shards of ice; brilliant, shining ice... Somehow I was transfixed by that ice..."

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: I think that's the gist of what Stanley told me. As I say, though, he was totally hammered by that point and what I actually got was the word salad version. Ironically, although he continued the story after sobering up, that's the part I don't remember so well...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: In principle, of course, you'd tackle a Cryo monster with Pyro.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: But that's easier said than done. Quite how much Pyro you would need to repel Cryo power of that magnitude is beyond me...

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: Ugh... I think I've had too much to drink again, I've got a headache setting in and my memory's gone foggy...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Not to worry — I sent someone out to investigate. Did you find the monster?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, but...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: ...Cryo Slime? Hmm. That doesn't seem to fit with the story Stanley told me.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: You didn't go to the wrong place, did you? Hey Stanley, what's your take on this?

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: *cough* *cough* Guess what — I just remembered this other story I never told you. Jack, you'll definitely want to hear this one!

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: But the Cryo Slime thing...

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: I guarantee you've never heard anything like this before. This one is from way, way, WAY back when I was...
